001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder;
002
003import java.time.ZoneId;
004import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
005import java.util.function.Consumer;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.LevelFormatter;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter.ThrowableFormatter;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.LogConfigurable.ConvertParameter;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.ExtendedFieldPrefix;
019import io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.JsonBuffer.JSONToken;
020
021/**
022 * A JSON encoder in the format produced by
023 * <a href="https://github.com/logfellow/logstash-logback-encoder">
024 * logstash-logback-encoder</a>'s <code>LogstashEncoder</code>.
025 * <p>
026 * Fields written: <code>@timestamp</code> (<code>ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME</code>, using
027 * {@link #zoneId()} - defaulting to the system default zone, matching the reference
028 * implementation), <code>@version</code> (constant <code>"1"</code>),
029 * <code>message</code>, <code>logger_name</code>, <code>thread_name</code>,
030 * <code>level</code>, <code>level_value</code> (Logback's conventional level integers:
031 * TRACE=5000, DEBUG=10000, INFO=20000, WARN=30000, ERROR=40000), and - only if a
032 * throwable was logged - <code>stack_trace</code> (the full stack trace as a single
033 * string).
034 * <p>
035 * <code>tags</code> (from SLF4J markers) is not implemented since Rainbow Gum core has no
036 * built-in {@code org.slf4j.Marker} support. MDC / key values have no reserved field so,
037 * matching the reference implementation, they are written as top-level fields using their
038 * own key name.
039 */
040public final class LogstashEncoder extends LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer> {
041
042        /**
043         * Logstash encoder URI scheme.
044         */
045        public static final String LOGSTASH_SCHEME = "logstash";
046
047        private final ZoneId zoneId;
048
049        private final boolean prettyprint;
050
051        private final DateTimeFormatter timeFormatter;
052
053        private final int maxBufferSize;
054
055        LogstashEncoder(ZoneId zoneId, boolean prettyprint, int maxBufferSize) {
056                super();
057                this.zoneId = zoneId;
058                this.prettyprint = prettyprint;
059                this.timeFormatter = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME.withZone(zoneId);
060                this.maxBufferSize = maxBufferSize;
061        }
062
063        /**
064         * The zone used to render <code>@timestamp</code>.
065         * @return zone id.
066         */
067        public ZoneId zoneId() {
068                return this.zoneId;
069        }
070
071        /**
072         * Creates a Logstash encoder using a lambda for easier registration. The builder will
073         * have properties loaded after the consumer has configured the builder.
074         * @param consumer lambda to configure builder.
075         * @return encoder provider.
076         */
077        public static LogProvider<LogstashEncoder> of(Consumer<LogstashEncoderBuilder> consumer) {
078                return (s, c) -> {
079                        var b = new LogstashEncoderBuilder(s);
080                        consumer.accept(b);
081                        return b.fromProperties(c.properties()).build();
082                };
083        }
084
085        /**
086         * Creates a Logstash encoder.
087         * @param name property name prefix.
088         * @param zoneId zone used for <code>@timestamp</code>, defaults to the system default
089         * zone.
090         * @param prettyPrint <code>true</code> will pretty print the JSON, default is false.
091         * @param maxBufferSize maximum buffer size - a soft ceiling checked between events,
092         * not a hard cap enforced on any single event (see
093         * {@link LogEncoder.Buffer#isOversized()}). A negative value (the default) disables
094         * this entirely.
095         * @return encoder.
096         */
097        @LogConfigurable(prefix = LogProperties.ENCODER_PREFIX)
098        static LogstashEncoder of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name,
099                        @ConvertParameter("convertZoneId") @Nullable ZoneId zoneId, @Nullable Boolean prettyPrint,
100                        @Nullable Integer maxBufferSize) {
101                prettyPrint = prettyPrint == null ? false : prettyPrint;
102                zoneId = zoneId == null ? ZoneId.systemDefault() : zoneId;
103                int _maxBufferSize = maxBufferSize == null ? -1 : maxBufferSize;
104                return new LogstashEncoder(zoneId, prettyPrint, _maxBufferSize);
105        }
106
107        static ZoneId convertZoneId(@Nullable String zoneId) {
108                return zoneId == null ? ZoneId.systemDefault() : ZoneId.of(zoneId);
109        }
110
111        @Override
112        protected JsonBuffer doBuffer(BufferHints hints) {
113                return new JsonBuffer(this.prettyprint, ExtendedFieldPrefix.AT, maxBufferSize);
114        }
115
116        @Override
117        protected void doEncode(LogEvent event, JsonBuffer buffer) {
118                buffer.clear();
119                var formattedMessage = buffer.getFormattedMessageBuilder();
120                event.formattedMessage(formattedMessage);
121                var now = event.timestamp();
122                var t = event.throwableOrNull();
123
124                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_START);
125                int index = 0;
126                index = buffer.write("@timestamp", timeFormatter.format(now), index);
127                index = buffer.write("@version", "1", index);
128                index = buffer.write("message", formattedMessage.toString(), index);
129                index = buffer.write("logger_name", event.loggerName(), index);
130                index = buffer.write("thread_name", event.threadName(), index);
131                index = buffer.write("level", LevelFormatter.toString(event.level()), index);
132                index = buffer.writeInt("level_value", levelValue(event.level()), index, 0);
133
134                if (t != null) {
135                        var stackTrace = new StringBuilder();
136                        ThrowableFormatter.appendThrowable(stackTrace, t);
137                        index = buffer.write("stack_trace", stackTrace.toString(), index);
138                }
139
140                var kvs = event.keyValues();
141                for (int i = kvs.start(); i >= 0; i = kvs.next(i)) {
142                        String k = kvs.key(i);
143                        String v = kvs.valueOrNull(i);
144                        index = buffer.write(k, v, index);
145                }
146
147                if (index > 0 && prettyprint) {
148                        buffer.writeLineFeed();
149                }
150                buffer.write(JSONToken.OBJECT_END);
151                buffer.writeLineFeed();
152        }
153
154        private static int levelValue(java.lang.System.Logger.Level level) {
155                /*
156                 * Logback's conventional level integers, which is what logstash-logback-encoder
157                 * writes as level_value.
158                 */
159                return switch (level) {
160                        case TRACE -> 5000;
161                        case DEBUG -> 10000;
162                        case INFO -> 20000;
163                        case WARNING -> 30000;
164                        case ERROR -> 40000;
165                        case ALL -> Integer.MIN_VALUE;
166                        case OFF -> Integer.MAX_VALUE;
167                };
168        }
169
170}
